research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Scanwell Health is engaged in research and development of diagnostic test kits and methods of analyzing them, as described in the title 'Diagnostic test kits and methods of analyzing the same.' The abstract details a diagnostic test kit that includes a test region for indicating results and a scan surface with control markings, aligning with the company's focus on urine testing applications. Their work centers on improving the analysis and usability of diagnostic test kits for health monitoring.
